original_variants.title: 清爽侧脸 · 束发
original_variants.specific: HEAD STYLE E1: handsome classical profile with ONE long eyebrow/eye stroke and one jaw contour; no lips, ear details or beard texture. Clean face with strong nose and chin silhouette. Hair consists of just TWO large forms: swept-back crown and a small tied bun, with only one angular hairline. A single BROAD tapered hair ribbon rises from the bun to the high original star HIP89341, made from two long sides and one bend, not a plume of hair strands. Heroic and graceful, quietly classical. This is the most balanced outline option. Text: only "E1" at the top-left inside frame, small clean sans-serif.
original_variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the approved E centaur archer composition. IMAGE 2 is its authoritative gold constellation layout. Reconstruct image 1 as BEAUTIFUL, PRACTICAL STRAIGHT-LINE ENGRAVING art for hand-scoring a 400 mm acrylic panel. Preserve E's exact expressive gesture: upper body in upper-right, face looking left-up, left arm fully extended with bow, right elbow drawn backward, arrow to left-up, four lifted horse legs, elegant long horse tail sweeping down the left side and curling at the bottom. Preserve the pose, adult anatomical proportions, horse shape, negative space and relationship with the gold star map. Gold stars and their connections belong to the shoulder/torso/horse spine and flowing tail; preserve image 2's original positions and gold graph. Main requested change: dramatically REDUCE THE COMPLEXITY OF FACE AND HAIR while keeping artistic grace. White engraving must be intentional SINGLE CONTOURS with a few selected internal anatomical strokes. No hatching, no shading, no repeated scratch strokes, no tiny triangles, no individual strands of hair, no portrait micro-detail, no eyelashes, no beard texture. The face profile, nose, jaw and neck connection must remain graceful and readable. Approximate organic contours using purposeful straight segments, mostly 8-30 mm long at panel scale; retain natural proportions, not childish geometric clipart, not a stick figure or dense triangle mesh. Consolidate body and leg linework into confident outlines and a modest amount of structure; tail consists of 4-6 broad tapered ribbons rather than many strands. Simplify curled bow terminals into elegant angular ends. Plain midnight-navy background, silver-white scoring lines and existing gold constellation, same thin square panel border. No physical photograph, no metallic fills, no additional ornaments or stars. Square artwork for easy side-by-side comparison.

abstract_variants.title: 大切面 · 星骨射手
abstract_variants.specific: STYLE E5: polished modernist constellation relief drawn only as fine engraved lines. Organize the entire centaur into 8-14 LARGE, asymmetric geometric structural facets that follow shoulder stretch, torso twist, horse hip and leg motion. NOT a uniform triangle mesh: large clean negative-space planes with only the essential facet boundaries, no more than 15 interior structural lines on the whole horse body and human torso combined. Face is a 4-6 segment slanted side silhouette with no internal detail. Hair consists of TWO large swept-back wedges only. Gold star lines become elegant seams between larger surfaces; when a gold seam provides a boundary, don't draw a parallel redundant silver line. Horse tail uses 2-3 elongated offset tapered wedges, in rhythm with the arrow. Preserve four readable legs and naturally tapering limbs. Abstract art sculpture, not low-poly computer wireframe. Text only "E5" small in upper-left inside frame.
abstract_variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the approved E pose and composition; image 2 is the original fixed constellation graph. Reinterpret the ENTIRE silver engraving as a more ABSTRACT, highly refined Sagittarius centaur artwork for manual straight-line scoring on acrylic. Keep E's iconic movement: noble archer at upper right aiming left-up, extended left arm and drawn-back right elbow, leaping four-legged horse body, long sweeping tail along the left edge curling at the bottom. Keep the fixed original 21 gold stars and 24 links of image 2 in their existing positions, beautifully integrating them as part of shoulder, bow, torso, horse back and tail, no extra stars or links. Prioritize artful proportions, tension, negative space and a coherent rhythm. ZERO eye/eyebrow/mouth/ear/beard detail; ZERO individual hair strands. A head with an elegant left-facing slanted silhouette is enough; anonymous celestial figure, not a literal portrait. A broad head ribbon or sculptural crest may rise to the original highest gold star but should be one integrated shape. All silver linework must be SELECTIVE LONG STRAIGHT SEGMENTS, single purposeful contours; no tiny hatching, scratches, curls, duplicated outlines, dense triangulation or small polygons. Anatomy suggested rather than meticulously described, expressive but not a children's pictogram or stick figure. Hands are 2-3 simple angular shapes with no individual finger texture, hooves are clean wedges. Plain same midnight-navy square background, silver-white linework and original gold constellation, same thin square panel border, no gray/white solid fill areas, no extra ornaments.

abstract_variants.title: 带状留白 · 流线射手
abstract_variants.specific: STYLE E6: sophisticated ART DECO abstract ribbon line sculpture. Construct the entire centaur from 3-5 flowing TAPERED RIBBON SHAPES whose edges are a small number of long straight segments and angled joints. One connected band suggests forehead-neck-chest-horseback-tail; a second band loops around the stretched bow arm and pulled-back shoulder; a third band suggests horse belly and branches into front and rear legs. Use thoughtful breaks in contours and broad negative spaces to imply overlap and anatomy. The face is a completely blank slanted side silhouette, no eye, nose interior, lips or hair lines. No individual muscle contours, abs or knuckles. Hair/crest is ONE broad tapered banner attached to the head. The gold graph runs inside bands as the luminous structural skeleton. Bow and arrow remain sharp and recognizable; tail becomes a single broad tapered flowing banner around the lower gold chain. Four legs are recognizable paired ribbon forms, never single sticks. Elegant and poetic reduction, cohesive original E gesture, not a generic logo. Text only "E6" small in upper-left inside frame.
